eyeContact.rule: hypot((yaw-baseYaw) + kX*(irisX-baseIrisX), (pitch-basePitch) + kY*(irisY-baseIrisY)) <= toleranceDeg; baselines come from the 5-second look-at-camera calibration
eyeContact.features: yaw/pitch (deg) from the facial transformation matrix (R = Ry Rx Rz); irisX = iris offset along the eye-corner axis, irisY = offset perpendicular to the corner line (not the eyelids, which move with gaze); both in eye-width units, image-right/down positive, averaged over both eyes
eyeContact.provenance: Constants chosen on Columbia Gaze (non-commercial, evaluation only); false-positive check on MPIIFaceGaze (CC BY-NC-SA, evaluation only).
